Why JB Tour

Why travel with us

Better value

As a licensed travel bureau, JB Tour receives group rates from airlines, hotels, restaurants, coach operators and local tour partners that are simply not available to someone travelling alone.

Nothing left to you

You do not need to worry about arranging anything. JB Tour handles it all — reservations, flights, hotels, restaurants, the tour schedule, and your travel documents.

A pilgrimage that is also a pleasure

Every programme is arranged around your preferences and kept as comfortable as possible. Each tour is led by an experienced tour leader and accompanied by a spiritual director, who adds to the spiritual depth of the journey.

Our Vision

“To make JB Tour the finest pilgrimage service for all Christian faithful, for the greater glory of God and the salvation of souls.”

About Us

Frequently Asked

The questions we hear most

Tell us what you have in mind — which programme, how many travelling, and roughly when. We will build the rest around it.

Chat on WhatsApp
Does a spiritual director accompany every group?

Yes. Every JB Tour departure is led by an experienced tour leader and accompanied by a spiritual director. That presence is what separates a pilgrimage from an ordinary tour, and what deepens the journey spiritually for everyone travelling.

What does JB Tour arrange for pilgrims?

We handle the whole journey: reservations, flights, hotels, restaurants, the tour schedule, and your travel documents. You do not need to assemble any of it yourself — which is why most pilgrims choose to travel as part of a group.

Can I save up for a pilgrimage?

Yes. One of our missions is to open the way for the faithful of every means to travel, by saving through a Parish, Church Treasurer or Church Cooperative. Contact us to discuss the arrangement that suits your parish or community best.

When do Holy Land departures run?

The Jerusalem programmes depart every month — both the nine-day itinerary and the longer versions combined with Egypt, Mount Sinai and Petra. For Europe, Asia, Turkey and Mexico, the departure months are listed against each programme on this page.

Are any programmes suitable for families with children?

Yes. The 15-day Rome–Lourdes–Paris–Disneyland + Switzerland and the 14-day Fátima–Lourdes–Paris–Disneyland + Switzerland programmes are scheduled for school holidays and Lebaran, pairing the pilgrimage with something children will enjoy.

How do I find out the price of a programme?

Pricing depends on the departure date, the airline and the size of the group, so we quote it per departure. Message us on WhatsApp or call the office with the programme and roughly when you would like to travel, and we will send you the details.

Ready to travel with us?

Tell us what you have in mind — which programme, how many travelling, and roughly when. We will build the rest around it.
